profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
With over two decades of cybersecurity expertise, Ramie has held a variety of executive and technical leadership roles, driving strategic initiatives and spearheading comprehensive security programs across multiple industries. As an Executive Cybersecurity Consultant, he has successfully guided high-profile clients in risk management, regulatory compliance, and cybersecurity strategy, helping organizations protect their critical assets while aligning security efforts with broader business objectives.

As Chief Security Officer for several organizations, Ramie has developed and implemented robust security frameworks, overseen complex incident response operations, and provided strategic direction on regulatory adherence. His expertise extends to the modernization of cryptographic systems, securing IoT ecosystems, and leading global cybersecurity teams—achievements that have earned him prestigious awards and numerous patents. Ramie has also led teams in secure software development, embedded systems design, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing, demonstrating his depth of technical leadership.

In addition to his corporate roles, Ramie founded, scaled, and successfully sold a technology and security services firm, where he designed secure cloud-based applications and managed projects across various sectors, including military, healthcare, and financial services. His experience in managing large-scale budgets, leading cross-functional teams, and fostering collaboration among key stakeholders has allowed him to expertly balance security with operational efficiency and business growth.

Throughout his career, Ramie has worked closely with C-suite executives and board members, delivering actionable insights that bridge the gap between technical security measures and business impact. He is dedicated to providing solutions that not only defend against cyber threats but also enhance organizational resilience and drive long-term strategic success.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build AI-assisted engineering workflows and agents to improve  development leverage and review quality, including prompt libraries,  code review workflows, comparison artifacts, and early internal AI  proof-of-concepts for security and platform engineering use  cases.
 
Build and evolve software components that automate trust data creation, signing, and deployment into production and fleet-facing  environments.
 
Lead architecture and delivery for enterprise PKI and digital trust  platforms, spanning platform modernization, certificate lifecycle  design, governance, and production support for security-critical  systems.
 
Build and launch trust infrastructure used to support electric vehicle  and partner ecosystem integrations, including certificate trust list  generation, signing workflows, and production rollout support.

Design and implement production certificate hierarchies and trust  chains to meet external onboarding and interoperability requirements for  connected vehicle platforms.
 
Lead migration planning and early implementation of an internally owned  PKI platform to replace legacy vendor solutions, reducing vendor lock-in  and positioning the organization for significant annual cost savings.

Define and advance data-validation solutions that identified  inconsistencies across multiple enterprise data sources before  downstream service activity, reducing unnecessary operational work and  customer-impacting errors.

Improvee operational resilience for authentication and certificate  services by resolving production issues, supporting infrastructure  changes, and stabilizing critical back-end security platforms.

positions.title: Staff Cybersecurity Engineer
positions.description:
Chair the SAE EVPKI Policy Authority, driving standards for secure cryptographic modernization and cross-network interoperability in the electric vehicle ecosystem

Architect secure device identity, registration, and trust management frameworks for GM’s connected IoT infrastructure, enabling scalable and resilient authentication across platforms

Lead the end-to-end migration of legacy on-premise PKI systems to Azure Cloud, improving operational efficiency, scalability, and security posture

positions.title: Engineering Group Manager, Product Cybersecurity Red Team
positions.description:
Awarded multiple patents throughout career; recipient of GM’s highest technical honor, the Boss Kettering Award (2019)

Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performing embedded cybersecurity testing team, specializing in vehicle-focused attack simulations

Oversee resource planning and cross-cultural collaboration across a global, multi-site team

Scope, coordinate, and execute penetration tests (black box), vulnerability assessments (grey box), and red team exercises (white box)

Deliver executive-level reports with actionable insights, clearly communicating testing methodologies, findings, and risk implications

Drive initial risk management processes, including severity assessment, prioritization, and remediation recommendations

Champion continuous improvement, applying industry best practices to enhance testing efficacy and team performance

Design and develop custom security tools tailored for automotive threat modeling and exploit simulation

positions.title: Senior Embedded Security Engineer
positions.description:
Lead secure software development and embedded systems design for vehicle communication and infotainment platforms

Drive the creation and enforcement of Android security standards for OEMs and vehicle application security frameworks

Spearhead the development of an advanced embedded firmware security evaluation tool

Conduct in-depth code and system analyses to deliver consistent, actionable risk assessments that support strategic risk management decisions

positions.title: Senior Security Architect
positions.description:
Ensured a secure software development lifecycle by identifying and assessing risks across information services, communication systems, mobile, and enterprise applications, recommending effective mitigation strategies for vulnerabilities and limitations

Led the development of security and cryptographic governance frameworks, policies, and standards to ensure PCI compliance

Conducted thorough code and system analyses, uncovering numerous vulnerabilities and developing proof-of-concept exploits to validate findings

Owned the security of back-office systems supporting secure over-the-air (OTA) programming for electronic control units (ECUs)

Designed and implemented comprehensive security test cases to validate control effectiveness

Executed advanced remediation efforts, including building a remote patching tool to address vulnerabilities in a globally distributed embedded telematics system

Responsible for the security posture of back-office infrastructure supporting telematics units

Led the security architecture design for next-generation virtual key technology

positions.title: AI & Cybersecurity Consultant
positions.description:
Driving strategic cybersecurity initiatives to strengthen enterprise security frameworks and reduce risk exposure for high-profile clients across regulated industries

Delivering expert guidance on regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001), security policy development, and enterprise risk management

Advising C-level executives on cybersecurity posture, investment priorities, and risk-informed budget planning

positions.title: Chief Security Officer
positions.description:
Spearheading the design and implementation of enterprise-wide security strategies to protect critical organizational assets and data

Driving compliance with industry regulations and frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, and SOC 2, ensuring continuous audit readiness

Overseeing end-to-end risk management, including the development of security policies, incident response planning, and vulnerability mitigation

Managing cybersecurity budgets and presenting actionable insights to executive leadership on RevKeep’s security posture, risk trends, and strategic priorities

positions.title: Founder, Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
Architected and designed the JEMS real-time secure video consultation cloud application, optimized for reliable delivery to smart devices even over challenging 3G/4G networks

Led efficient development management, driving cost savings of hundreds of thousands of dollars

Designed robust incident response and business continuity systems to ensure operational resilience

The architecture successfully passed rigorous security evaluations by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and multiple hospital systems

positions.title: Founder, Consultant
positions.description:
Business responsibilities include leadership, strategy, budgets, planning, mentoring, policies, reporting, sales, and contract negotiations for over 30 staff members. Responsible for information systems security, governance, management, architecture, and engineering spanning numerous clients and environments. Legal tasks include source code analysis, analyzing network devices and computers, and serving as a technical expert witness. Utilize best practices including ITIL, ISO/IEC, PCI, NIST SP 800 series, and NISPOM. Lead and assume full responsibility for many different projects, here is a partial list of representative projects:

Designed, presented, and gained executive acceptance for a data loss prevention plan for a Fortune 500 manufacturer by identifying and presenting specific risk metrics

Led a hospital based installation of EMR software, associated hardware, and secure IPSEC VPN connectivity to over 70 remote sites that are subject to HIPAA regulations

Designed and implemented security programs and standards to meet ITAR and NISP requirements for chemical and automotive manufacturers to obtain military contracts

Implement and maintain the technology systems and security of a large call center that is subject to PCI regulations and required to pass regular audits

Architected and installed the secure point-of-sale network, ticketing system, and public Wi-Fi access for a large entertainment stadium

Conducted penetration testing and create detailed documentation for a financial services company to test incident response and increase management security awareness

Constructed, presented, and ensured audit success of an electronic communications plan and technology control plan for a military textile and chemical manufacturer

Secure and maintain Industrial Control Systems (ICS) for a large materials processing site

Identified, evaluated, and made recommendations on emerging security technologies

positions.title: Chief Security Officer, Chief Embedded Engineer
positions.description:
Authored and presented research papers on advanced cryptography topics

Developed, analyzed, and implemented cryptographic ciphers and key management solutions for high-security environments

Designed and built hard drive and file-based encryption software to protect sensitive data

Architected and developed network interface encryption filter drivers to secure data in transit

Specialized in optimizing cryptographic performance and security within embedded systems

Designed and implemented Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) cryptographic systems to enable robust authentication and encryption

positions.title: Instuctor
positions.description:
Delivered vendor-certified training and mentorship for Microsoft, Cisco, and project management certifications, achieving consistently high student certification success rates

Designed and developed hands-on labs that enabled practical application of skills to real-world, security-focused scenarios, significantly enhancing comprehension and knowledge retention

positions.title: Server and Network Technician
positions.description:
Demonstrated expertise as a computer, server, and enterprise network technician

Managed and optimized the application validation and testing lab to ensure quality and reliability

Led the successful implementation of the enterprise asset inventory program, improving tracking and accountability

educations.fieldOfStudy: Liberal Arts and Sciences, General Studies and Humanities
